breakdown.description: The prescribed global x-directed shear traction is replaced by a boundary-normal pressure on the slope
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The incomplete prompt incorrectly re-defined a horizontal shear traction as a normal pressure. The ground truth clarifies that the load should be a 'global x-directed traction, not a normal pressure'. The generated specification repeated the error from the incomplete prompt by instructing to 'Apply a uniform inward normal traction of magnitude 2000 Pa on the sloping edge'.
